description: This file defines a Compose UI screen for the Post-Onboarding tab view in an Android application. It manages various tabs such as Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings, handling navigation, status display, and user interactions within the onboarding flow.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: Enum class representing the different tabs in the UI with a label and an icon.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: Enum class representing visual status indicators such as Connected, Connecting, Warning, Error, and Offline.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function for rendering the post-onboarding UI with tab navigation and status bar.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Composable for displaying the screen tab content, managing refresh logic when connected.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Composable for rendering the status bar at the top, showing connection status and messages.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Composable for rendering the bottom navigation bar with tabs.
